newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oki to develop Internet money transfer system.
newsitem.headline: Oki to develop Internet money transfer system.

text.p: Oki Electric Industry Co Ltd said on Thursday that it had started developing next-generation electronic commerce applications.
The applications include an Internet payment system based on Java, a computer programming language.
A prototype of the new Internet money transfer system will be previewed at an exhibition on July 9 and be available for commercial use in the spring of 1998, Oki said in a statement.
The new system will allow users to make payments for banking and shopping services through a variety of electronic payment systems, including the Mondex cash card system, the statement said.
